questions.question: For Systems Development Manager Network Core, coding rounds are:
options: Possible but uncommon for SDM—confirm with recruiter; SysDE ICs often do get coding
questions.explanation: IGotAnOffer SDM <6% coding; SysDE Blind differs.

questions.question: A Bar Raiser is in the loop to:
options: Protect the hiring bar independently of team urgency
Lower the bar to fill headcount

questions.question: Manager loops differ from IC primarily by:
options: More Hire/Develop, org impact, and stakeholder stories — still technical Dive Deep
questions.explanation: NDM JD emphasizes both technical leadership and people management.

questions.question: Bar Raiser role is best described as:
options: An objective interviewer protecting the hiring bar and LP signal quality
A random peer with no notes

questions.question: Dive Deep surprise for managers:
options: Interviewers may push past high-level slides into mechanisms and metrics
questions.explanation: JD: dive deep with engineers; interviewers test that.

questions.question: AGSVA clearance on an AU Network Core role means:
options: Eligibility/suitability for government vetting can be required — plan accordingly
Only US citizens apply in AU
questions.explanation: Explicit JD requirement for this posting.

questions.question: If recruiter is vague on coding for NDM:
options: Ask explicitly what rounds exist: LP, networking deep-dive, coding, bar raiser

questions.question: STAR stories that fail Bar Raisers often:
options: Hide the candidate's actions in "we" and lack metrics

questions.question: Unique large-customer requirements (JD) imply interviews may probe:
options: Handling exceptions without breaking shared platform safety
questions.explanation: Role serves large customers with unique needs.

questions.question: On-call management questions may ask:
options: How you design rotations, escalations, and reduce pages

questions.question: Invent and Simplify trap:
options: Building a complex custom tool when a standard mechanism exists
Removing toil with a simple guardrailed tool

questions.question: Deliver Results follow-up you should expect:
options: What was your baseline? What did YOU do? What changed quantitatively?
